## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /page — 1cr

Returns data from a Linkbio page including display name, bio, avatar, and list of links with titles and URLs.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Full URL of the Linkbio page

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/linkbio/page?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## What Linkbio is for

One endpoint, `/page` (1cr): the links behind a creator's bio link — effectively their offer
ladder in their own words and order.

Same job as `linktree`, different service. Read the handle's bio to see which link-in-bio host
they actually use before calling; the five hosts (`linktree`, `linkbio`, `linkme`, `komi`,
`pillar`) are not interchangeable.

> ⚠️ `prism/lookup` (0cr) does not resolve link-in-bio URLs — verified 07.10.26 in this
> workspace. Go straight to `/page`.
